newsitem.title: GERMANY: Conti confirms Benecke-Kaliko sale report.
newsitem.headline: Conti confirms Benecke-Kaliko sale report.

text.p: Germany's largest tyre maker, Continental AG, on Wednesday confirmed newspaper reports that it selling its shareholding in car component supplier Benecke-Kaliko AG in Hanover.
A report in Wednesday's business newspaper Boersen-Zeitung said Conti wanted to sell its 50.1 percent holding in the company. The remaining 49.9 percent belongs to DG Bank.

"There have been negotiations about the sale of the whole Benecke-Kaliko group. DG Bank wants to dispose of it as it is not part of its core business, and it is also not part of our core business," said a Continental spokesman.
"Obviously we can't say anything about who is involved or when the sale will be complete at the moment," the spokesman said.
In 1995 Benecke had sales of 570.7 million marks, with net profits of 14.8 million marks. The group had a payroll of 2,023 employees in that year.
